Active advisory — issued June 22, 2026 at 8:00 a.m.

Boil-water advisory in effect for Harbor District (Zones 3 & 4)

Residents and businesses in the Harbor District should boil tap water for at least one minute before drinking, cooking, or making ice. The advisory follows a routine sample that returned elevated turbidity levels. Bottled water is available at the Harbor District Fire Station (47 Wharf Street), 8 a.m.–8 p.m. daily. Read full advisory and treatment instructions.

From the Town

News & notices

All public notices →

  • Public Safety June 22, 2026

    Boil-water advisory issued for Harbor District (Zones 3 & 4)

    A routine quarterly sample collected on Saturday returned elevated turbidity. Residents in affected zones should boil water for one minute before use until further notice. Bottled water distribution begins at the Harbor District Fire Station.

  • Construction June 19, 2026

    Mill Road bridge repair begins July 6 — detour via Cobbett Bridge

    Department of Public Works crews will replace the steel deck on the Mill Road bridge over Cobbett River. The bridge will close to vehicles for approximately eight weeks. Pedestrian crossing remains open on the north sidewalk.

  • Meeting June 17, 2026

    Select Board to consider FY27 budget amendments on July 1

    The Select Board will hold a public hearing on five proposed line-item amendments to the FY27 operating budget, including additional funding for storm-drain maintenance and the Council on Aging transportation program.

  • Environment June 15, 2026

    Weekly bacterial monitoring begins at Sand Bar Beach

    The Health Department’s seasonal monitoring program is underway. Sample results are posted every Tuesday by 4 p.m. Beach status flags (green, yellow, red) are updated at the bathhouse and on the town website.

  • Elections June 12, 2026

    Early voting locations and hours for September 8 primary

    In-person early voting will be available at the Public Library Community Room and at the Harbor District Fire Station from August 22 through September 4. Drop boxes for mail ballots are located at Town Hall and the Library.

  • Community June 10, 2026

    Summer concert series at Common Park begins Thursday, July 9

    The Cultural Council’s eighteenth annual concert series runs Thursday evenings, July 9 through August 27. Performances begin at 6:30 p.m. on the Bandstand. Free; bring chairs or blankets. Rain location: Memorial Hall.

1 Cobbett Square, Millbrook, MA 02XXX
